name: Moribayashi Ichigo
source:
She is the twin of Remon. She lost her parents in a fire.

She wears bandages to hide her burns. She is a smart girl, but a bit childish.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/st/index.html]official site[/url]]
